title: Two men at the door explain the implant and say Raudive invented it

tellings.quote: then uh he says it was invented by a man named Constantine Raw. And they leave.

plain: In 2025, two men came to an apartment in California, explained an implant, a small device said to have been placed in a person's body, and said it was invented by a man named Konstantin Raudive. The author Whitley Strieber, known for writing about his own encounters with beings he calls visitors, says this happened to him: the men told him it "was invented by a man named Constantine Raw. And they leave."
